description: Cross-harness matrix suite for the storage plugin's 13 skills (aws-s3, azure-blob, ceph, dell-powerstore, dell-unity, gcs, glusterfs, hpe-alletra, minio, netapp-ontap, overview, pure-storage, storage-spaces-direct). Prompts are deliberately neutral (no mention of a skills library or documentation) so the no-skill arm is not tipped off. Every expected answer is traceable to cited content shipped in each skill's SKILL.md. knowledge: 'recent' = fact a bare model plausibly lacks (post-cutoff or niche); 'stable' = long-standing fact a strong bare model may know.

tasks.prompt: What durability percentage does AWS specify for objects stored in the Amazon S3 Standard storage class? Answer concisely.
tasks.notes: plugins/storage/skills/aws-s3/SKILL.md - Durability: 99.999999999% (11 nines) across minimum 3 AZs (Standard)

tasks.prompt: Amazon S3 supports server-side encryption with customer-provided keys, SSE-C. As of the most current guidance, when is AWS disabling SSE-C by default? Answer concisely.
tasks.notes: plugins/storage/skills/aws-s3/SKILL.md - Key Security Features: SSE-S3 default encryption (SSE-C disabled by default April 2026)

tasks.prompt: For Amazon S3 Glacier Deep Archive, how many days must an object sit before a lifecycle rule can transition it there, and roughly how long can retrieval take? Answer concisely with both figures.
tasks.notes: plugins/storage/skills/aws-s3/SKILL.md - Storage Classes table: Glacier Deep Archive min storage 180 days, retrieval 12-48 hours

tasks.prompt: In Azure Blob Storage, if a blob sits in the Archive access tier, what is the minimum retention period in days, and roughly how long can rehydration retrieval take? Answer concisely with both figures.
tasks.notes: plugins/storage/skills/azure-blob/SKILL.md - Access Tiers table: Archive min retention 180 days, retrieval up to 15 hours

tasks.prompt: Which Azure Storage redundancy option keeps six copies of data spread across three availability zones plus a paired region, while also allowing reads from the secondary region? Answer concisely.
tasks.notes: plugins/storage/skills/azure-blob/SKILL.md - Redundancy table: RA-GZRS = 6 copies, 3 zones + paired region, secondary reads Yes

tasks.prompt: In Azure Storage, what capability must be enabled on a storage account before you can use NFS 3.0 or SFTP access? Answer concisely.
tasks.notes: plugins/storage/skills/azure-blob/SKILL.md - ADLS Gen2 section: Enabled by hierarchical namespace (HNS); required for NFS 3.0 and SFTP

tasks.prompt: When sizing Ceph placement groups, what is the recommended target range of PGs per OSD across all pools? Answer concisely.
tasks.notes: plugins/storage/skills/ceph/SKILL.md - Placement Groups: Target 100-200 PGs per OSD

tasks.prompt: For a Ceph replicated pool configured with size equal to 3, what percentage of raw capacity ends up usable? Answer concisely.
tasks.notes: plugins/storage/skills/ceph/SKILL.md - Pool Types table: Replicated (size=3): 33% usable, tolerate 2 failures

tasks.prompt: Which Ceph major release introduces FastEC erasure coding along with a management gateway and an integrated SMB Manager? Give the release name and version number. Answer concisely.
tasks.notes: plugins/storage/skills/ceph/SKILL.md - Version-specific guidance: Tentacle 20.2: FastEC, mgmt-gateway, oauth2-proxy, certmgr, integrated SMB Manager

tasks.prompt: Dell PowerStore guarantees a minimum data reduction ratio on PowerStore Prime without needing a pre-assessment. What is that guaranteed ratio? Answer concisely.
tasks.notes: plugins/storage/skills/dell-powerstore/SKILL.md - Always-On Data Reduction: 5:1 guaranteed (PowerStore Prime, no pre-assessment)

tasks.prompt: For Dell PowerStore Metro Volume synchronous replication, what is the maximum supported distance between sites, in kilometers? Answer concisely.
tasks.notes: plugins/storage/skills/dell-powerstore/SKILL.md - Metro Volume: Up to 96 km / 5ms RTT

tasks.prompt: Dell discontinued one SupportAssist connectivity method for PowerStore. Which method, and roughly when? Answer concisely.
tasks.notes: plugins/storage/skills/dell-powerstore/SKILL.md - Critical Operational Knowledge: SupportAssist Direct Connect discontinued Dec 2024; all clusters require Secure Connect Gateway (SCG)

tasks.prompt: Dell Unity XT all-flash array models reached end-of-sale on what date? Answer concisely.
tasks.notes: plugins/storage/skills/dell-unity/SKILL.md - Lifecycle Status table: AFA models end-of-sale August 1, 2025

tasks.prompt: Dell UnityVSA ships in two editions with different capacity caps. What is the maximum capacity for the free Community Edition versus the Professional Edition? Answer concisely with both figures.
tasks.notes: plugins/storage/skills/dell-unity/SKILL.md - Core Architecture: UnityVSA Community Edition (4 TB) and Professional Edition (50 TB)

tasks.prompt: In Dell Unity, is FAST Cache applicable to all-flash array pools? Answer with yes or no and a brief reason.
tasks.notes: plugins/storage/skills/dell-unity/SKILL.md - FAST Cache: Secondary SSD cache at 64 KB granularity, for hybrid pools only (not applicable for AFA)

tasks.prompt: For the Google Cloud Storage Archive storage class, what is the minimum storage duration in days before you avoid an early deletion fee? Answer concisely.
tasks.notes: plugins/storage/skills/gcs/SKILL.md - Storage Classes table: Archive Min Duration 365 days

tasks.prompt: Google Cloud Storage dual-region buckets offer a fast replication mode with an SLA-backed recovery point objective. What is that time objective, and what flag enables it? Answer concisely.
tasks.notes: plugins/storage/skills/gcs/SKILL.md - Bucket Locations: Turbo Replication: 15-minute RPO SLA (--rpo=ASYNC_TURBO)

tasks.prompt: Under Google Cloud Storage Autoclass, objects smaller than what size always remain in the Standard storage class regardless of access pattern? Answer concisely.
tasks.notes: plugins/storage/skills/gcs/SKILL.md - Autoclass: Objects < 128 KiB stay Standard

tasks.prompt: As of the latest guidance, what is the current stable release version number of GlusterFS? Answer concisely.
tasks.notes: plugins/storage/skills/glusterfs/SKILL.md - This skill covers GlusterFS distributed filesystem (current stable: 11.2)

tasks.prompt: When did Red Hat Gluster Storage reach end of life? Answer concisely.
tasks.notes: plugins/storage/skills/glusterfs/SKILL.md - Project status: community-maintained, Red Hat Gluster Storage EOL Dec 2024

tasks.prompt: When formatting GlusterFS bricks with XFS, what isize value is required to properly store extended attributes? Answer concisely.
tasks.notes: plugins/storage/skills/glusterfs/SKILL.md - Critical Rules: Format bricks with XFS and isize=512

tasks.prompt: For the HPE Alletra 9000, what maximum IOPS figure is quoted for a 4-node 9080 configuration? Answer concisely.
tasks.notes: plugins/storage/skills/hpe-alletra/SKILL.md - Critical Numbers table: Max IOPS 2.1M (9000, 4-node 9080)

tasks.prompt: When using the HPE CSI Driver for Kubernetes, what is the maximum number of characters allowed in a node hostname? Answer concisely.
tasks.notes: plugins/storage/skills/hpe-alletra/SKILL.md - Critical Numbers table: K8s hostname limit 27 characters (CSI Driver)

tasks.prompt: In November 2025, HPE discontinued several third-party storage software partnerships to focus on its own storage IP. Which partnerships were dropped? Answer concisely.
tasks.notes: plugins/storage/skills/hpe-alletra/SKILL.md - Strategic Direction: In November 2025, HPE discontinued Qumulo, Scality, and WEKA partnerships

tasks.prompt: MinIO archived its open-source community edition repository on what date, and under what license did it remain available? Answer concisely.
tasks.notes: plugins/storage/skills/minio/SKILL.md - Licensing table: Community (OSS) Archived Feb 13, 2026, AGPLv3

tasks.prompt: A MinIO erasure set traditionally supports up to 16 drives. What is the increased maximum drives per erasure set introduced in AIStor starting in 2026? Answer concisely.
tasks.notes: plugins/storage/skills/minio/SKILL.md - Storage Hierarchy: Erasure Sets (4-16 drives, up to 32 in AIStor 2026+)

tasks.prompt: In MinIO erasure coding, if an erasure set has N drives, what is the minimum number of drives required to accept a write, expressed as a formula in terms of N? Answer concisely.
tasks.notes: plugins/storage/skills/minio/SKILL.md - Erasure Coding table: Write minimum drives (N/2) + 1

tasks.prompt: For NetApp ONTAP MetroCluster with automatic unplanned switchover, what recovery time objective, in seconds, is targeted? Answer concisely.
tasks.notes: plugins/storage/skills/netapp-ontap/SKILL.md - Data Protection Stack table: MetroCluster RTO < 120 seconds (AUSO)

tasks.prompt: ONTAP 9.18.1 introduces two security-hardening capabilities for the cluster back-end network and encryption. Name them. Answer concisely.
tasks.notes: plugins/storage/skills/netapp-ontap/SKILL.md - Version-specific guidance: ONTAP 9.18.1: mTLS for cluster back-end network, post-quantum algorithm support

tasks.prompt: For NetApp ONTAP volume utilization monitoring, what are the warning and critical percentage thresholds? Answer concisely with both numbers.
tasks.notes: plugins/storage/skills/netapp-ontap/SKILL.md - Key Operational Metrics table: Volume utilization Warning 80%, Critical 90%

tasks.prompt: For database or VM storage workloads that need block access, should a team choose object storage such as S3 or MinIO instead? Answer with yes or no and a brief reason.
tasks.notes: plugins/storage/skills/overview/SKILL.md - Anti-Patterns: 'Object storage for databases' - Object storage has high latency and no random write support; Decision Framework: Database/VM storage - Avoid object storage

tasks.prompt: At what data scale does storage architecture guidance recommend moving to scale-out platforms like Ceph or cloud object storage instead of traditional enterprise arrays? Answer concisely.
tasks.notes: plugins/storage/skills/overview/SKILL.md - Step 3: Scale and performance: > 1 PB: Scale-out (Ceph, cloud object storage)

tasks.prompt: According to current guidance comparing software-defined object storage options, what changed about MinIO licensing as of February 2026? Answer concisely.
tasks.notes: plugins/storage/skills/overview/SKILL.md - Technology Comparison table: MinIO trade-off: Object-only, commercial licensing since Feb 2026

tasks.prompt: Pure Storage SafeMode locks immutable snapshots for a default retention period, extendable up to a maximum. What is the default number of hours, and what is the maximum number of days? Answer concisely with both.
tasks.notes: plugins/storage/skills/pure-storage/SKILL.md - SafeMode: Immutable snapshots locked for configurable period (24h default, up to 30 days)

tasks.prompt: For Pure Storage ActiveCluster synchronous replication, what is the maximum round-trip time, in milliseconds, supported between sites? Answer concisely.
tasks.notes: plugins/storage/skills/pure-storage/SKILL.md - Replication section: ActiveCluster: max 11 ms RTT

tasks.prompt: Pure Storage FlashArray has been marketed under a new brand name since when? Give the name and roughly when the change took effect. Answer concisely.
tasks.notes: plugins/storage/skills/pure-storage/SKILL.md - This skill covers Pure Storage FlashArray (marketed as Everpure since February 2026)

tasks.prompt: For Windows Storage Spaces Direct on Windows Server 2019 and later, what is the maximum storage pool size and the maximum capacity per server? Answer concisely with both figures.
tasks.notes: plugins/storage/skills/storage-spaces-direct/SKILL.md - Key Limits table: WS2019+: Max pool 4 PB, Max per server 400 TB

tasks.prompt: Windows Server 2025 adds an NVMe-oF initiator to Storage Spaces Direct. What IOPS improvement does this deliver? Answer concisely.
tasks.notes: plugins/storage/skills/storage-spaces-direct/SKILL.md - Identify version: WS2025: NVMe-OF initiator (+90% IOPS)

tasks.prompt: For Storage Spaces Direct nested two-way mirror resiliency, what percentage of raw capacity ends up usable as storage efficiency? Answer concisely.
tasks.notes: plugins/storage/skills/storage-spaces-direct/SKILL.md - Resiliency Options table: Nested two-way mirror: Efficiency 25%, Min Nodes 2 (exactly)
